source.title: Dusky Pigment — original comment recounting Briarthorn and Swiftthistle milling

quote: 4 groups of Briarthorn; 2 groups of Swiftthistle. Each time I got 2-3 Dusky Pomace.
notes: Original author's distinct Briarthorn cohort: 4 completed groups crushed, all yielded 2–3 old-named Dusky Pomace per operation, mapped to Dusky Pigment 39334. No count of exact 2-vs-3 results, no total units or build/skill. This is an early Wrath-era pre-release terminology observation, not validated current Retail evidence. 5 herbs per mill from historical Milling spell 51005; no outputs of other materials inferred.
